subject: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-07-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)

Marissa / Ben / Mina,

Quick ask — Aureus Labs (product analytics for clinical trials) is asking for a 30% off list Hosted API usage rate for a 12-month committed pilot. Context:
- They want to onboard 3 regions (US + EU staging) with an expected ramp to ~120M tokens/month by month 6.
- They are committing to a 12-month reserved spend of $320k monthly (invoice upfront monthly), plus a 2-year evaluation clause.
- The engineering team has already validated model compatibility with our runtime; they want predictable unit cost.

Why this matters:
- Strategic: strong healthcare reference in NA + EU, case study potential, and possible marketplace co-sell.
- Upside: Renewal conversations expected in Q3 next year; if successful, likely to expand to Dedicated.

Ask: approval for a one-time concession of 30% off our standard Hosted API token rates for the first 12 months, with standard terms otherwise (no changes to data residency/KMS requirements). We will require a signed SOW + prepay/committed monthly invoice.

Attachments: SOW redline + pricing workbook (numbers are modeled there).

If you want, I can loop in Legal for the SOW tweaks; they flagged a short audit access clause but nothing blocking.

Thanks — will be grateful for a fast turn (Aureus execs want a final number by EOD tomorrow).

— Priyom
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T10:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)

Priyom —

Thanks for the summary. A few quick clarification items before I can sign off:
1) What is the net ARR impact for year 1 with this concession (net of credits/commits)? Do the numbers in the workbook include expected overage charges?
2) Are we getting any legal protections for churn (e.g., minimum committed term + early termination claw)?
3) Is there margin buffer for us if they exceed tokens early? (want to avoid surprise gross margin erosion)

Can you also confirm the HubSpot deal link and attach the latest product evaluation signoff? If numbers look sane I can escalate to Ben for final executive approval today.

— Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)

Marissa — answers below and I updated the workbook as requested (v3 attached):

1) Net ARR impact Y1: with 30% concession the modeled net ARR is ~$2.75M over 12 months (committed invoices + estimated overages). Workbook tab "FinanceModel" shows monthly burn and margin. Overage assumptions: conservative — we bill standard overage rates after commitment; workbook shows a 10% buffer.
2) Legal protections: SOW includes 12-month committed term and an early termination clause with a 60-day notice and pro-rated clawback of unearned credits for early termination. Legal reviewed the redline; they raised the audit-access timeframe which I've accepted at 30 days.
3) Margin: At the concession level and expected token mix, gross margin remains north of 38% according to finance modeling (Mina can confirm). We propose applying dynamic throttling to protect unit economics if tokens spike >150% of forecast in any month (standard language we use).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company.com/deal/5421 (deal record with forecasted numbers).
SOW redline and pricing workbook attached.

If everyone is good, Aureus wants the final commercial email tonight; they asked for a signed SOW by Friday to meet their internal board review.

— Priyom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)

Thanks team — I reviewed the workbook and call notes. The strategic rationale is solid: healthcare reference, multi-region footprint, and likely migration path to Dedicated. Mina — I need your confirmation on the margin floor and the proposed throttling clause. If we can keep margin >=35% and add the throttling, I approve a one-time 30% concession for the first 12 months under these constraints.

Please:
- Priyom: prepare the commercial email and attach the redlined SOW; include the early termination clawback language and throttling guardrails.
- Marissa: once Priyom posts the commercial email, I'll authorize legal to sign off and Ben (me) will provide exec signoff in HubSpot.

I'll also mark this deal as "Exec-sanctioned — conditional" in our internal deal tracker.

— Ben
VP Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-21T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Exec approval for strategic Hosted API concession — Aureus Labs (30% off)

All good — Mina confirmed margin floor via quick ping (>= 36% after concession).

Priyom, please send the commercial email to Aureus with the attached SOW redline and the prepaid invoice schedule. Copy Legal and Finance on the send (I've looped Legal already). Once you have Aureus' signed SOW, route to Ben and I'll update the deal stage to "Closed - Exec Concession" pending signature.

Cc: Legal@redwood.ai, finance_ops@redwood.ai

— Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
